messages.subject: error with survey design
parts:
I got this error when I attempted to create a point random sampling design. I am guessing that it is a conversion problem with my GIS data. I attempted to run the data projected and in the imported WGS 84 format, but the same error occured. I also made sure to use the appropriate sampler radius as well. I am not sure why it would say 'point sampler and survey region do not intersect' even when I keep everything in WGS 84 format.

Initializing
Updating survey properties to correspond with design New Design
Starting design engine
** Error: Unexpected error in Design Engine.
Error number: -2147213503
Error source: D5DesEng.ModDesignEnginePointUtilities.CalculateCircleSamplerIntersection
Error description: Point sampler and survey region do not intersect in 'ModDesignEnginePointUtilities.CalculateCircleSamplerIntersection' .
Log:
About to read design definition.

About to read design definition.
Initializing general design properties.
Selecting the design class.
Selecting the design sampler.
Initializing the point sampler properties.
Generating samplers in stratum 1.
** Error: Point sampler and survey region do not intersect in RunDesignEngine. **
**

thanks
Aaron Howard
